convert_hf_model_to_gguf: convert a HuggingFace transformers model directory to GGUF format for llama.cpp inference
convert_quantized_model_to_gguf: dequantize and convert a GPTQ or FP8 quantized HuggingFace model to GGUF format
convert_multimodal_model_to_gguf: convert a vision or audio multimodal model's projector weights to separate GGUF mmproj file
convert_moe_model_to_gguf: convert a Mixture of Experts model like Mixtral or DeepSeekV2 to GGUF with merged expert tensors
register_custom_model_architecture: register a new model architecture class with ModelBase.register decorator to support conversion of custom models
